about: VST parameter -> FM8E payload field plus measured transfer function. Each entry was validated by reconstructing the stored bytes at all 9 sweep points (0..1 in eighths). Measurements only; no Native Instruments code or data.

encodings.f32: LE float32, value = a + b*v (quantised=true means the engine rounds it)
encodings.uN: LE integer of N*8 bits, value = round(a + b*v) mod 2^N
